title: Activation-Energy Pruning for Spiking Neural Networks: Unsupervised Personalization via Spike-Count Saliency
abstract: arXiv:2609.26167v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Activation-energy pruning -- removing weights whose product of magnitude and cumulative pre-synaptic spike count falls below a threshold -- was established as an effective unsupervised personalization strategy for conventional deep neural networks~\citep{BINGHAM2025101242}. This paper asks what happens when the same criterion is applied to spiking neural networks (SNNs), where activation energy is not merely a useful heuristic but a literal physical quantity proportional to the metabolic cost of each synapse. The answer is surprising on three counts.   First, gradient-based pruning methods that perform competitively on conventional networks (SNIP, GraSP, magnitude pruning) consistently underperform on SNNs, collapsing to near-chance accuracy by $\sigma = 0.2$ sparsity across all tested architectures and datasets. translated_title: 面向脉冲神经网络的激活能剪枝：基于脉冲计数显著性的无监督个性化
translated_abstract: 激活能剪枝——即移除权重幅值与突触前累积脉冲计数乘积低于阈值的连接——此前已被确立为传统深度神经网络的一种有效的无监督个性化策略。本文探讨当同样的剪枝准则应用于脉冲神经网络（SNN）时会产生什么结果；在SNN中，激活能不仅仅是一种有用的启发式指标，而是与每个突触代谢成本成正比的真实物理量。答案在三个方面出人意料。首先，在传统网络上表现具有竞争力的基于梯度的剪枝方法（SNIP、GraSP、幅值剪枝）在SNN上持续表现不佳，在所有测试的架构和数据集上，当稀疏度达到 σ = 0.2 时准确率即崩溃至接近随机水平。我们将这一现象归因于代理梯度显著性估计与二值脉冲序列表示之间存在的系统性不兼容……
tldr: 该论文首次将激活能剪枝准则引入脉冲神经网络，揭示了基于梯度的剪枝方法（SNIP、GraSP、幅值剪枝）因代理梯度显著性与二值脉冲序列表示的系统性不兼容而在SNN上失效，而直接基于突触前脉冲计数、与生物代谢能耗物理量成正比的激活能剪枝则成为更有效的无监督个性化剪枝策略。
en_tdlr: This paper extends activation-energy pruning to spiking neural networks, showing that gradient-based pruning methods (SNIP, GraSP, magnitude pruning) collapse on SNNs due to the systematic incompatibility between surrogate-gradient saliency and binary spike-train representations, while physically grounded activation-energy pruning based on pre-synaptic spike counts offers a superior unsupervised personalization strategy.
